bullets.text: spent the morning deleting more than i wrote. the file got shorter and somehow louder.
duck at tatsue-ji, ninety-nine km in. the river moved, the mountain in it held still. line says the fight lives in the watcher.
the kettle and the rain started in the same second. neither one asked the other to.
steady. like a stone that has given up on being thrown.
an argument needs two. the river only brought one.
